records.name: Chevening Scholarships 2027/28
records.field_eligibility: Eligible one-year taught master's courses in the United Kingdom.
records.nationality_eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries or territories; applicants must check their country page.
records.tuition_coverage: Tuition fee payment is listed as part of the award coverage.
records.accommodation_coverage: A monthly living allowance is intended to cover accommodation and living expenses.
records.travel_allowance: Economy travel to and from the country of residence is listed.
records.health_insurance: Visa-related support is listed; applicants should verify healthcare and visa details for their country.
records.application_fee_info: No Chevening application fee is stated in the verified source excerpts.
records.english_language_requirement: Applicants must meet the English and academic requirements of their chosen UK universities.
records.standardized_test_requirement: No general GRE requirement is stated; requirements depend on chosen university courses.
records.minimum_academic_requirement: Applicants need an undergraduate degree that qualifies them for a UK master's programme.
records.application_method: Apply through the Chevening online application system via the applicant's country or territory page.
records.notes: Seed data verified from official Chevening pages on 2026-07-22. Students must still check their country page.
eligibility_warnings: Country-specific Chevening pages may contain additional instructions.
University course admission requirements are separate from Chevening eligibility.

source.title: Chevening application timeline
source.relevant_excerpt: Official timeline states applications open on 4 August 2026 and close on 6 October 2026.

additional_sources.title: Chevening eligibility criteria
additional_sources.relevant_excerpt: Official eligibility page lists citizenship, return-home, work experience, degree, and course-choice requirements.

additional_sources.title: What does a Chevening Scholarship cover?
additional_sources.relevant_excerpt: Official FAQ lists tuition, travel, allowances, visa application cost, and monthly personal living allowance.

records.name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars 2027 Cohort
records.field_eligibility: Any Stanford graduate degree field, subject to admission to the chosen Stanford programme.
records.nationality_eligibility: Citizens and residents of all countries may apply.
records.tuition_coverage: A fellowship is applied directly to cover tuition and associated fees.
records.accommodation_coverage: A stipend supports living and academic expenses.
records.travel_allowance: A travel stipend is intended for one annual economy-class trip to and from Stanford.
records.health_insurance: Applicants should verify health insurance details with Stanford and programme-specific funding information.
records.application_fee_info: Applicants must also apply to Stanford degree programmes; programme application fees may apply.
records.english_language_requirement: English and test requirements depend on the selected Stanford graduate programme.
records.standardized_test_requirement: Standardized-test requirements depend on the selected Stanford graduate programme.
records.minimum_academic_requirement: Applicants must meet Stanford graduate admission requirements and KHS undergraduate-degree timing rules.
records.application_method: Submit the Knight-Hennessy Scholars application and a separate Stanford graduate programme application.
records.notes: Seed data verified from official Knight-Hennessy Scholars pages on 2026-07-22.
eligibility_warnings: Stanford graduate programme deadlines and requirements are separate.
This seed record uses masters as a representative degree level, but KHS supports multiple graduate degree types.

source.title: Knight-Hennessy Scholars admission
source.relevant_excerpt: Official admission page states the 2027 cohort application closes on 6 October 2026 at 1 pm Pacific.

additional_sources.title: Knight-Hennessy Scholars eligibility
additional_sources.relevant_excerpt: Official eligibility page lists Stanford admission and undergraduate-degree timing as baseline requirements.

additional_sources.title: Knight-Hennessy Scholars funding
additional_sources.relevant_excerpt: Official funding page lists tuition fellowship, living stipend, academic-expense support, and travel stipend.
